name: ac.arcademia.leaderboards
description: Submit high scores and let players claim them to their Arcademia account, from any Unity game running on an Arcademia arcade cabinet or on a developer's own machine (sandbox mode). See Runtime/README.md and the online SDK docs for full usage.

samples.description: A single MonoBehaviour with an on-screen panel exercising every SDK call (ping, submit score, fetch test scores, claim). Drop it into any scene to try the SDK end to end.
